not_a_claim_of: generalization beyond the BioASQ secondary snapshot

freeze_timing.disclosure: The source-informed v2 protocol, all source measurements, public case identities, and LION's published aggregate evaluation were visible. No BioASQ candidate score, case rank, percentile, surfaced bridge list, development result, or held-out result was computed before this freeze.

primary_source.citation: Pyysalo et al. (2019), LION LBD: a literature-based discovery system for cancer biology

research_basis.adopted_design: LION's default open-discovery configuration uses Jaccard edge weights, minimum path aggregation, and sum accumulation across linking paths.
material_differences: LION uses sentence-level entity co-occurrence over a heterogeneous concept graph; this formula uses binary article-level MeSH descriptor co-occurrence.
LION's retrospective evaluation deletes documents where named A and C co-occur; this experiment retains every article and reports direct A-C counts.
LION's published aggregate results informed the formula choice, so this is a literature-grounded baseline rather than an independent method search.
The BioASQ cases and source counts are known, although no BioASQ metric output has been computed.

graph_contract.article_labels: binary unique descriptor set; duplicate assignments are an error
graph_contract.support: n_x is the number of included articles containing descriptor x
graph_contract.cooccurrence: n_xy is the number of included articles containing both distinct descriptors x and y
graph_contract.eligible_node_set: V_t contains every descriptor x with n_x >= threshold t
graph_contract.eligible_edge: An undirected edge (x,y) exists when x and y are distinct members of V_t and n_xy > 0
graph_contract.candidate_set: For seed A, rank every C in V_t except A, including candidates with a direct A-C edge.
graph_contract.bridge_set: For a candidate C, use every B in V_t except A and C where n_AB > 0 and n_BC > 0.
graph_contract.direct_ac_policy: Never delete A-C articles, never exclude C because n_AC > 0, report n_AC, and do not use n_AC as a separate score feature.

edge_weight.name: article_jaccard
edge_weight.domain: distinct eligible descriptors joined by an eligible edge
edge_weight.zero_policy: A missing edge contributes no path rather than an edge of weight zero.

path_and_candidate_score.candidate_formula: S(A,C) = sum(P(A,B,C) for B in bridge_set(A,C))
path_and_candidate_score.interpretation: A candidate scores highly when A and C have many shared linking descriptors with balanced Jaccard strength on both sides; this is a graph association measurement, not a generated hypothesis.

numeric_reproducibility.arithmetic: Python decimal.Decimal only; binary floating point is forbidden for persisted scores
numeric_reproducibility.edge_weight_evaluation: construct Decimal from integer counts, then divide under the frozen context
numeric_reproducibility.summation: sum path Decimal values in descriptor_ui ascending order under the frozen context
numeric_reproducibility.persisted_score_rounding: quantize once after the full sum using ROUND_HALF_EVEN

ranking_contract.primary_orientation: rank target C conditioned on seed A
ranking_contract.candidate_order: persisted score descending, descriptor_ui ascending for display only

feature_exclusions: named target identity as a feature
named positive bridge identity as a feature
direct A-C count as a separate feature, penalty, filter, or bonus
MeSH tree distance, parent, child, or sibling relationship

execution_isolation.allowed_first_run: development cases only, at support 10 and 5
execution_isolation.heldout_prohibition: Do not compute, cache, log, persist, or preview any held-out score, rank, percentile, candidate ordering, or surfaced bridge list under the initial formula.
execution_isolation.shared_graph_rule: Corpus graph construction may be shared across cases only when it is case-label-blind and does not materialize held-out candidate scores.
execution_isolation.output_path_rule: Development output must be written to a new checksum-addressed review artifact and must refuse overwrite.
execution_isolation.revision_rule: After development, either freeze this exact formula as final or freeze at most one separately named revision contract before rerunning development. The held-out layer remains prohibited until the final formula contract is pinned.
execution_isolation.no_silent_tuning: Changing a threshold, edge weight, path aggregation, accumulation, precision, tie rule, or candidate filter creates a formula revision and consumes the single revision budget.

development_reporting: Report all 11 development cases at support 10 and 5 without denominator shrinkage.
For every case report endpoint supports, direct A-C count, eligible candidate count, persisted target score, worst-tie rank, rank fraction, and top contributing B terms.
Keep source-labelled positives, ontology-generated controls, measured counts, and metric outputs structurally distinct.
Report runtime, peak storage, graph edge count, source checksums, protocol checksum, formula checksum, and exact command.
Do not present development performance as held-out validation, discovery truth, metric-v3 readiness, or permission to add an LLM interpretation layer.
limitations: The formula choice is informed by LION's published results and is not an independent comparison of LBD formulas.
Article-level MeSH co-occurrence differs materially from LION's sentence-level heterogeneous entity graph.
Known case identities and source measurements allow inadvertent tailoring even though BioASQ metric outputs remain unseen.
Sum accumulation can reward candidates with many weak shared bridges and may retain degree bias despite Jaccard normalization.
MeSH ontology proximity is intentionally not filtered, so hard controls can expose taxonomy confounding.
Retaining direct A-C articles differs from classic undiscovered-link evaluation and permits already co-occurring targets.
The snapshot omits or thins non-academic, practitioner, craft, indigenous, humanities, and historical knowledge.
No outcome contributes metric-v3 readiness, validates gap discovery, generalizes outside this pilot, or authorizes an LLM interpretation layer.
